entities.name: QueC Q981C9
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Saccharolobus solfataricus 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine synthase Q981C9; 464 aa.
Annotated as ATP-dependent conversion of 7-carboxy-7-deazaguanine to 7-cyano-7-deazaguanine (preQ0), EC 6.3.4.20.
UniProt annotation reports one Zn2+ ion per subunit and placement in preQ0 biosynthesis/purine metabolism.
Sequence properties: calculated mass 52.38 kDa and theoretical pI 6.20; Pfam includes GATase_7 and QueC domains.
